info.name: HRM.API — Organization, Employees & System Administration
info.description: 119 source-backed REST endpoints; 129 request examples. Leave/Overtime/Approval/Attendance adjustment APIs and configurable workflow. See docs/modules/Leave/API.md. Mutations are manual; no migrations/deployment are executed by this collection. Leave Balance Management: carried-over/adjustment/remaining/available amounts, scoped create-only bulk grants with operationId, adjustments with reason/version and balance audit history. See docs/modules/Leave/BALANCES_API.md. My leave balance and configurable month/year recurring positional grants/reset via System Settings; disabled sample policy. Approvals is now a parent module with Leave/Overtime/Attendance child examples; source endpoint count remains119.

item.name: Notifications

request.description:
Inbox riêng của JWT sub
Permission: JWT; recipient ownership
Query limit=30 (clamp 1–100), beforeId nullable (cursor ID).
Chỉ PUBLISHED và user hiện tại; không tin userId query. Offline đồng bộ API.
Expected 200; errors 401, 500.

Đếm chưa đọc
Permission: JWT; recipient ownership
Không có query/path/body.
Chỉ thông báo đã phát hành của sub.
Expected 200; errors 401, 500.

Đánh dấu một thông báo
Permission: JWT; recipient ownership
Path notificationId BIGINT.
Idempotent; non-recipient trả 404.
Expected 204; errors 401, 404, 500.

Đánh dấu toàn bộ inbox hiện tại
Permission: JWT; recipient ownership
Không có query/path/body.
Không thay đổi trạng thái đọc của user khác.
Expected 200; errors 401, 500.

Lưu announcement draft hoặc lịch
Permission: WEB_NOTIFICATIONS: USER→SEND_USER; USERS/ROLE/DEPARTMENT/CUSTOM→SEND_GROUP; ALL→SEND_ALL; thêm SCHEDULE khi có scheduledAt
Header Idempotency-Key bắt buộc <=100 ký tự; scheduledAt UTC tương lai tùy chọn.
Target allowlist/OR/distinct, không SQL; cùng key khác payload 409. Worker xử lý sau. Xem NOTIFICATION_CENTER.md cho đầy đủ target.
Expected 201; errors 400, 401, 403, 409, 500.

Đưa draft vào outbox
Permission: WEB_NOTIFICATIONS: kiểm tra từng quyền gửi của target đã lưu; SCHEDULE nếu có lịch
Path notificationId BIGINT.
Không fanout đồng bộ HTTP. Không publish source nội bộ qua API này.
Expected 202; errors 401, 403, 404, 409, 500.

Hủy trước phát hành
Permission: WEB_NOTIFICATIONS / CANCEL
Path notificationId BIGINT.
Chỉ DRAFT/SCHEDULED; PUBLISHED trả 409; cancel lặp idempotent.
Expected 200; errors 401, 403, 404, 409, 500.

item.description: Existing async module. Run create → publish → wait for worker → inbox/count/read manually. Cancel a DRAFT/SCHEDULED before publication. Set notificationId before read requests.

request.description: Tạo Employee bằng WEB_EMPLOYEES/NEW và scope NEW ALL hoặc DEPARTMENT đúng phòng ban. Không gửi employeeCode: backend tự sinh NV + Id (tối thiểu 6 chữ số), giữ unique index. Client gửi field thừa employeeCode bị bỏ qua. Response 201 EmployeeDto trả employeeCode; lỗi rollback không để lại code tạm. Mã cũ không đổi, code không đổi khi cập nhật. Department/Team/Position theo validation hiện có. Muốn tạo cùng User, dùng POST /api/users với createEmployee=true.

Danh sách hồ sơ trong scope
Permission: WEB_EMPLOYEES / VIEW + SELF/DEPARTMENT/ALL
Query page>=1 (default 1), pageSize=1..100 (default 30), search<=150; total tính sau filter/scope. Query departmentId positive nullable; employmentStatus<=20.
Scope áp trước count/paging/search. Department query không mở rộng scope.
Expected 200; errors 400, 401, 403, 500.
Response EmployeeDto có teamId/teamName nullable. Danh sách hỗ trợ teamId filter chỉ thu hẹp data scope.
Response EmployeeDto có departmentId/departmentName, teamId/teamName, positionId/positionName; tên nullable, giữ các field hồ sơ cũ. Backend AsNoTracking + LEFT JOIN + Select DTO, không N+1; names đọc trực tiếp từ response, không ghép catalog ở client. Giữ WEB_EMPLOYEES/VIEW và SELF/DEPARTMENT/ALL. Scope/filter và Count trước paging, Id tăng dần. Có migration PositionId/TeamId trong source; Applied/Pending DB đích chưa được xác minh, không tự apply.

Xem lịch sử hồ sơ
Permission: WEB_EMPLOYEES / VIEW + row scope
Path employeeId; Query page>=1 (default 1), pageSize=1..100 (default 30), search<=150; total tính sau filter/scope.
Lịch sử được tạo qua nghiệp vụ chuyển phòng ban; không cho client ghi lại actor hoặc sửa/xóa lịch sử. Chưa gán chức danh vì Employee không có PositionId.
Expected 200; errors 400, 401, 403, 404, 500.

Cập nhật thông tin hồ sơ
Permission: WEB_EMPLOYEES / UPDATE + ALL/DEPARTMENT
Path employeeId; body DTO đầy đủ.
Không đổi employeeCode/hireDate/department qua endpoint này. Birth/email/length/status validation. PUT giống dữ liệu hiện tại không phát thêm audit/notification. Notification + audit cùng transaction.
Expected 200; errors 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500.
TeamId tùy chọn, phải active và cùng Department. PUT bỏ teamId giữ Team cũ; null gỡ Team. Response có teamId/teamName. positionId=null gỡ vị trí khi PUT; gửi ID hiện tại nếu muốn giữ.

Chuyển phòng ban, tạo lịch sử
Permission: WEB_EMPLOYEES / UPDATE + ALL
Path employeeId; body departmentId là số nguyên.
Phòng đích ACTIVE và khác phòng hiện tại; effectiveDate từ hire/latest history đến hôm nay UTC; không lên lịch tương lai. Actor từ JWT. Employee/History/Audit/Notification/Outbox commit hoặc rollback cùng nhau.
Expected 200; errors 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500.
TeamId phải thuộc Department đích và active; null/bỏ qua gỡ Team cũ. Audit trước/sau cùng transaction; response có teamId/teamName.

Tạo hồ sơ hợp đồng
Permission: WEB_CONTRACTS / NEW + ALL/DEPARTMENT
Path employeeId; không nhận employeeId khác trong body.
No<=50 unique; type<=30; start>=hireDate; end>=start; status allowlist; ACTIVE chứa hôm nay và không trùng khoảng ACTIVE khác. HTTPS attachment<=500, không có credentials, server không fetch URL. Audit/notification atomic.
Expected 201; errors 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500. ContractType must reference configured contract_types.code (active for new/type changes). Responses add contractTypeName. See docs/modules/Employees/CONTRACT_TYPES_API.md. ContractNo is generated on creation and immutable on update. Active ContractType with valid prefix required. See docs/modules/Employees/CONTRACT_NUMBERING.md.

Danh sách hợp đồng nhân viên
Permission: WEB_CONTRACTS / VIEW + employee row scope
Path employeeId; Query page>=1 (default 1), pageSize=1..100 (default 30), search<=150; total tính sau filter/scope.
Không truy vấn hợp đồng nhân viên ngoài scope. search chỉ theo contractNo.
Expected 200; errors 400, 401, 403, 404, 500. ContractType must reference configured contract_types.code (active for new/type changes). Responses add contractTypeName. See docs/modules/Employees/CONTRACT_TYPES_API.md. ContractNo is generated on creation and immutable on update. Active ContractType with valid prefix required. See docs/modules/Employees/CONTRACT_NUMBERING.md.

Chi tiết hợp đồng
Permission: WEB_CONTRACTS / VIEW + employee row scope
Path employeeId INT, contractId BIGINT.
Contract phải thuộc đúng employeeId; mismatch/outside scope trả 404.
Expected 200; errors 401, 403, 404, 500. ContractType must reference configured contract_types.code (active for new/type changes). Responses add contractTypeName. See docs/modules/Employees/CONTRACT_TYPES_API.md. ContractNo is generated on creation and immutable on update. Active ContractType with valid prefix required. See docs/modules/Employees/CONTRACT_NUMBERING.md.

Sửa hợp đồng / chuyển trạng thái
Permission: WEB_CONTRACTS / UPDATE + ALL/DEPARTMENT
Path employeeId, contractId; body DTO đầy đủ.
Giữ quy tắc tạo. ACTIVE chỉ giữ ACTIVE hoặc sang EXPIRED/TERMINATED; đóng cần endDate<=hôm nay; bản ghi đóng immutable, PUT dữ liệu giống hệt vẫn 200 không tạo event trùng. Không có DELETE hợp đồng.

Version 2: defaultDaysPerCycle defaults to 1 annual-leave day. Empty rules are allowed. ACTIVE eligible employees without a matching position rule (including no position) use the default. Matching position rules replace the default; never add both. Legacy version 1 remains position-only.

WEB_SYSTEM_SETTINGS/UPDATE only, no scope/Employee/balance permission required. Version2 has independent accrualSchedule and resetSchedule, each startDate,interval1..120,unit MONTH|YEAR. First execution is after a full interval. daysPerCycle is the award per cycle, not multiplied by interval. Omit leaveTypeId to default active ANNUAL balance-tracked leave. Reset skips missing quota and never creates rows. Policy disabled in sample; read current version and review schedules before enabling. Legacy policy remains supported. See docs/modules/Leave/ACCRUAL_SETTINGS.md.
Version 2: defaultDaysPerCycle defaults to 1 annual-leave day. Empty rules are allowed. ACTIVE eligible employees without a matching position rule (including no position) use the default. Matching position rules replace the default; never add both. Legacy version 1 remains position-only.

WEB_SYSTEM_SETTINGS/UPDATE only, no scope. Run latest due saved cycle, never force a future date; first execution requires full interval after anchor. Reset first, then grant if still applicable. Missing quota is skipped by reset; credit creates missing eligible quota. Period receipts prevent duplicates. Response counters remain unchanged. Manual authorized mutation only. See docs/modules/Leave/ACCRUAL_SETTINGS.md.
Inspect status/message, matchedEmployees, eligibleEmployees, nextAccrualDate and nextResetDate. Zero-credit cycles permit retry; positive completion prevents duplicate credit. Past anchors accepted: 2026-10-16 +1 MONTH run on 2026-11-17 credits November 16 and returns next date December 16. Start anchor remains unchanged.
Version 2: defaultDaysPerCycle defaults to 1 annual-leave day. Empty rules are allowed. ACTIVE eligible employees without a matching position rule (including no position) use the default. Matching position rules replace the default; never add both. Legacy version 1 remains position-only.

WEB_APPROVAL_SETTINGS/UPDATE. USER selects an active employee by employeeId; backend resolves the active linked user and snapshots the employee/user assignment. Approve/reject recheck that the acting user is still linked to that employee. No HR role required for USER. HR legacy still uses userId/roleCode. Use current settings version. GET settings first and replace version=0 with the current version. PUT replaces all routes. TEAM_LEAD and DEPARTMENT_MANAGER automatically resolve managers from teams/departments; do not supply employeeId/userId for those steps. USER requires approverEmployeeId variable. Missing managers, repeated approvers or disallowed self-approval fail submission. Existing pending steps keep their assignment. See docs/modules/Leave/WORKFLOW_SETTINGS.md and migration 20261117043059_SnapshotApprovalEmployee; this collection does not apply migrations. Owned by Modules/Approvals. Existing routes, permissions and payloads are preserved. Request types must be registered through IApprovalModule; max100 distinct configured types. See docs/modules/Approvals/API.md.
